Making the World’s Leading Organizations Resilient to DDoS Attacks

Unlike traditional DDoS defense solutions and red team testing, MazeBolt provides continuous, automated vulnerability testing without disrupting normal business activities. Something which has never been possible – until now.

As a result, organizations can now address vulnerabilities and validate and strengthen their DDoS defenses long before they’re attacked.

So we’re not just another cybersecurity company. We’re creating the new, gold standard in DDoS security – and we’re inviting exceptional talent to shape it with us.
